facts.text: `InteractiveMode.bindCurrentSessionExtensions()` calls `session.bindExtensions` with a TUI `uiContext` and `mode: "tui"`, and `AgentSession._applyExtensionBindings` forwards that context through `runner.setUIContext`. The ExtensionUIContext surface (`onTerminalInput`, editor/header/footer, `custom`) is described in the blocker doc. Inspected from vendored source only, not run.

Pi's `InteractiveMode.init()` calls `this.ui.start()` before extension initialization, so a `session_start` extension runs after Pi's TUI already owns the terminal. An extension-only Tern frontend therefore cannot select a different frontend for ordinary `pi`; this is the blocker recorded in `docs/reference/pi-tern-extension-default-blocker.md`.

`pi -r`/`--resume` opens a startup session picker (`selectSession` in `main.ts`) and returns `SessionManager.open(...)` directly, without `runtimeHost.switchSession`. In-session `/resume` goes through `handleResumeSession`, which calls `runtimeHost.switchSession`.

The Swarm system prompt text lives in `prompts/swarm-system-prompt.md` as `<!-- section: ... -->` blocks. `packages/context/prompt/src/index.ts` parses them and exports `forgeSwarmSystemPrompt`, `swarmForgeDelegationAddendum`, and `swarmForgeSystemPrompt` (forge + delegation). The earlier claim of vendored `forge-swarm.txt`/`delegation-addendum.txt` assets and a `scripts/sync.mjs` regenerator is stale; those files do not exist.

`assembleForgePrompt` in `extensions/swarm-prompt/extension.ts` builds the Swarm system prompt, and `registerSwarmPrompt` hooks it on `before_agent_start` to rewrite `event.systemPrompt`. The `applyWorkflowGuidance` / `packages/context/prompt/src/workflow-guidance.ts` part is unsupported because that file does not exist in the repo.

`extensions/clover-startup/extension.ts` registers the `/tern-setup` command with description "Install or remove the optional Tern Pi shell integration". The handler calls `ternSetupWizard(ctx, REPO_ROOT)` from `.pi/lib/ui/tern-setup-wizard.ts` and reports the result or error with `ctx.ui.notify`.

In `extensions/clover-startup/extension.ts`, the `session_start` handler calls `ternSetupWizard(ctx, REPO_ROOT, { startup: true })` after the header is set. It returns early for non-`startup` reasons and for print/json or `hasUI === false`. It notifies only on `installed:` or `conflict:` results, or on errors. Decline/EOF/unsupported-shell/already-installed skip writes, per `docs/reference/tern-setup-wizard.md`.
